name: What is the difference between a general contractor and an interior designer for renovations?
description: A general contractor executes the renovation, managing construction and trades, while an interior designer focuses on aesthetic and functional design choices.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a general contractor and an interior designer for renovations?

acceptedAnswer.text: A general contractor manages the construction and execution of a renovation project, overseeing trades, schedules, and budgets. An interior designer focuses on the aesthetic and functional design aspects, selecting materials, colors, and layouts. While a designer creates the vision, the contractor brings it to life. We often collaborate closely with designers or can assist with design elements as part of our service.
